Mei · Berco character 02 · identity pack

Internal review, not for publishing. Face by Jim, pack by Claude. A synthetic person: never named, never presented as a client. Built 2 November 2026.
Who: Filipino-Chinese, late forties, a calm host. Kept exactly as Jim made her.
Kept apart from Bea: long hair against Bea's bob; navy, charcoal and white against Bea's cream; stacked hoops against studs; her own Berco kitchen.
Element: MEI-Berco. Every scene states one Look word for word and says she is alone in the frame.
Spent: about 29 credits.

Jim's original (the face we kept)

Jim's front shot. Her face is held exactly; the pack is built around it.

Master portrait

The truth for every image of Mei. Face match to Jim's front 0.83. Skin now natural and matte (Jim's set had an AI sheen). Marks: small mole low on her right cheek near the jaw, a dot at the outer corner of her right eye, freckle scatter. Two stacked gold hoops per ear.

Both eyes closed, real teeth, hair moving. 0.59 (eyes shut always costs points). Carries the master's open neckline; scenes state her Look exactly.

Short natural nails, veins, freckles, thin gold bands. One panel put the stacked rings on a ring finger instead of the index: scene prompts state it exactly.

Test frame, attempt 1 (FAILED)

Test frame, attempt 2 (PASS)

Master added as a second anchor, tighter frame. 0.58. Note the stray blurred person at the right edge: 'looking at someone off camera' was taken literally. Scene prompts now say she is alone in the frame.
